value_unit: 1000 current USD in source CSV; current USD in browser and derived tables
light_consumer_definition: Research-defined broad light-consumer basket, not an official statistical category. WITS consumer goods in HS61, HS62, HS64 or HS6309, plus WITS consumer goods classified as low-technology manufactures excluding HS01-24,27,30,84,85,87. Shares use all recorded merchandise; China share uses the broad import basket. GDP and population denominators are same-country, same-year WDI observations; missing denominators remain missing.
top_products: Top 100 per country, year, flow and HS level (2/4/6); ranks by current USD, ties by HS code
partner_coverage: All-partner totals remain six benchmark years. China-origin imports are annual.
